problem.passage:
In the $xy$-plane, lines $j$ and $k$ intersect at one point. Line $j$ and line $k$ are shown in the graph.

What is the $x$-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations represented by lines $j$ and $k$?
problem.stimulus: In the $xy$-plane, lines $j$ and $k$ intersect at one point. Line $j$ and line $k$ are shown in the graph.
problem.question: What is the $x$-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations represented by lines $j$ and $k$?
problem.explanation: 직선 $j$는 $y = x + 1$, 직선 $k$는 $y = -x + 5$입니다. 두 직선의 교점은 연립방정식 $$\begin{cases} y = x+1 \\ y = -x+5 \end{cases}$$ 의 해입니다. 두 식을 같다고 놓으면 $x+1 = -x+5$, 즉 $2x = 4$, $x = 2$입니다. 그림에서도 두 직선이 $x=2$ 근처(점 $(2,3)$)에서 만나는 것을 확인할 수 있습니다. 따라서 $x$좌표는 $2$입니다.
problem.explanationEn: Line $j$ has equation $y = x + 1$, and line $k$ has equation $y = -x + 5$, as read from the graph (y-intercepts of 1 and 5, slopes of 1 and -1 respectively). Setting the two expressions for $y$ equal gives $x + 1 = -x + 5$, so $2x = 4$ and $x = 2$. This matches the graph, where the lines appear to cross near $(2, 3)$. Therefore, the x-coordinate of the solution is $2$.

difficultyReasons: 두 일차식을 연립하여 x+1=-x+5 를 풀면 2x=4, x=2로 단일 단계 대수 계산
